constant_level_ablation.intervention: Replace the full residual contribution of VQ level 5 with zero before generation of finer levels; regenerate all downstream codes
constant_level_ablation.caveat: Selected after observing constant VQ codes; tests contribution of a common learned offset, not sample-specific information or metacognitive control.

notes: All counts describe offline decoder readouts, not an explicit grid state fed back to the generator.
Transition analyses count individual cells; inferential resampling must group by puzzle.
A prospective probe must exclude all step-9 codes, logits and decoded predictions if its observation time is before step 9.
This is post-hoc assessment of hypotheses; no confirmatory testing or causal learning-history conclusion.
